\"A könyvet\" – это конкретное, определё: In Olvastam a könyvet (“I read the book”), a könyvet is a definite direct object, so the verb takes definite conjugation. In Olvastam egy könyvet (“I read a book”), the object is indefinite, so the verb takes indefinite conjugation. The two first-person past forms happen to look the same.
\"Bár\" (или \"habár\") переводится как: Bár (or habár) translates as "although"/"despite the fact": "Elmentem, bár fáradt voltam." (I went, although I was tired).
\"Ezért\" означает «поэтому» и указывает: "Ezért" means "so" and indicates the consequence: "Esik az eső, ezért itthon maradunk." (It's raining, so we stay at home). "Mert" - "because" and indicates the cause: "Nem jöttem, mert beteg voltam." (I didn't come because I was sick).
\"Hogy\" + повелительное наклонение = «ч: In “Azért jöttem, hogy segítsek”, hogy introduces purpose and segítsek is a felszólító form; natural English is “I came to help” or “so that I could help”. In the other examples, hogy introduces content and often corresponds to English “that”.
\"Lennél\" – это условная форма от \"len: Lennél is the second-person singular conditional of lenni (“you would be”). The whole expression is a very polite request: “Would you be so kind as to help?” (Lesson 23, slide 4).
\"Mert\" – это причинный союз, переводит: Mert is a conjunction meaning “because”: Nem jöttem, mert beteg voltam. (“I did not come because I was ill.”)

Венгерский различает не просто русское «: Hungarian distinguishes not a single English preposition such as “in”, but
Венгерский часто опускает местоимение, е: Hungarian often omits the pronoun if the participant is already clear from the situation, but omission does not mean that the object is always written inside the verb ending.
Венгерский язык часто строит длинные сло: Hungarian often builds long word forms, but meaning is not expressed by endings alone. Verb prefixes, postpositions, auxiliary constructions, and word order are also important.
Венгерский — агглютинативный язык. Грамм: Hungarian is an agglutinative language. Grammatical meanings are often expressed by suffixes attached to a word stem in a particular order.
Венгерское название профессии не меняетс: Hungarian profession names do not change for gender: orvos can refer to a doctor of any gender. The person’s gender, when relevant, comes from the name or context. This is similar to many modern English profession words.

Венгерское окончание винительного падежа: The Hungarian accusative ending continues to mark the direct object even when word order changes. Position mainly helps organize what is already known, what is new, and what the speaker emphasizes.
Венгерское прошедшее время одно как прод: Hungarian uses one productive past-tense morphology. English may render the same Hungarian past form with the Past Simple or Past Continuous depending on context, the verb, and any verbal prefix. Главная ловушка: в венгерском s обознача: Key trap for English speakers: Hungarian s is /ʃ/, like sh in ship, while sz is /s/, like s in see. This is the opposite of what English spelling may suggest.
Главная модель этого слайда: перед сущес: In Hungarian, an attributive adjective normally comes before the noun and stays unchanged; number and case are marked on the noun. This is fairly familiar to English speakers because English attributive adjectives also do not agree with the noun.
Главная ошибка: оставить предмет без при: The main mistake is leaving the possessed noun without its possessive suffix: not *Nekem van egy autó, but Nekem van egy autóm. English normally says “I have a car”, so do not copy the English structure word for word.
Главная формула всего урока:: The main formula of the whole lesson:
Главная функция — предложить время, прин: The main communicative goal is to suggest a time, accept it, or suggest a different one.
Главная цель 10.1 — не выучить все вариа: The main goal of 10.1 is not to memorize every suffix variant but to distinguish the three spatial relations immediately. Vowel harmony and the choice between -ban/-ben, -ba/-be, and -ból/-ből are covered in 10.2.
Главная цель 7.1 — научиться замечать пр: The main goal of 7.1 is to recognize the direct object. In Hungarian, a noun used as a direct object normally carries the accusative marker -t; the main formation patterns are covered in 7.2.
Главная цель — узнать контраст, а не выу: The main goal is to learn the contrast, not to learn the second paradigm by heart.
Главная цель: понятный маршрут и коррект: Main goal: a clear route and correct L11 forms.
Главная часть сообщает действие или резу: The main clause states an action or result, while the mert-clause gives the reason. A comma separates the clauses.
The main course is rántott sajt.
Главное о j и ly:: Key point about j and ly:

Главный навык 19.7 — не считать каждую ф: The main skill in 19.7 is not to treat every present-tense form as an event happening now. Consider the time marker, the paragraph, and the overall plan.
Главный навык урока — не узнавать оконча: The main skill is not spotting endings by sight, but explaining the verb form through the direct object.
Главный результат урока — не запомнить о: The main goal of the lesson is not to memorise one suffix, but to be able to explain why a particular form fits a particular situation.
Главный результат урока — не запомнить ш: The main outcome of the lesson is not memorizing six suffixes separately, but reliably following the sequence: spatial meaning → Hol/Hová/Honnan → place's case family → vowel-harmony variant → complete form.
Главный результат урока — не список меди: The main outcome of the lesson is not a list of medical words, but the ability to describe a fictional condition clearly, answer questions, understand a simple instruction, and clarify anything unclear.
Главный результат урока — не список терм: The main result of the lesson is not a list of terms, but the ability to choose the appropriate model for a particular work situation.
Главный результат урока — способность пр: The main outcome of the lesson is the ability to handle one coherent travel scenario: choose transport, buy a ticket, solve a station problem, check in at a hotel, and ask for directions.
Главный результат урока — уметь не тольк: The main goal of the lesson is not only to build the form, but also to explain why it is needed in a particular utterance.
Глагол \"eszik\" (есть) – неправильный:: The verb eszik (“eat”) is irregular: its past-tense form is evett, not the expected *eszett. Vár, kér, and tanul follow regular past-tense patterns.
Глагол \"lenni\" (быть) в повелительном: The verb lenni (“to be”) has an irregular imperative stem: légy! for te. Legyen! is the ő/Ön form (“let him/her/it be” / formal “be”).
Глагол kér — просить, запрашивать и зака: The verb kér: asking for, requesting, and ordering
Глагол köt — вязать, завязывать и связыв: The verb köt: to knit, tie, bind, or connect
Глагол lenni не образует повелительные ф: The verb lenni does not form its imperative with the simple visible -j pattern. Learn its forms as a set.
Глагол lenni непереходный: он не имеет о: The verb lenni is intransitive, so it has no separate definite conjugation. Choose the form only by person and number.
Глагол vár — «ждать»: полная парадигма и: The verb vár (“to wait”): full paradigm and use
Глагол «köhög» (кашлять) в 1-м лице един: The verb köhög (“to cough”) in first-person singular is köhögök: “I am coughing / I cough”.
Глагол «быть»: формы настоящего времени: The verb “to be”: present-tense forms and two different rules
Глагол движения сам по себе не выбирает: The verb of motion does not itself choose a family: the forms szobába, postára and Péterhez all respond to Hová?, but express different spatial relationships.
Глагол движения сам по себе недостаточен: A motion verb is not enough by itself. For example, “moving toward a destination” and “moving away from a place” require different questions.
Глагол не заменяет падеж. Как и на 10.6,: The verb does not determine the case. As in 10.6, a location form is determined by its role in the situation.
Глагол переходный, но здесь говорящий со: The verb is transitive, but here the speaker talks about reading without referring to a specific text already known from context. Therefore the indefinite conjugation is used.
Глаголы разные, но пространственная роль: The verbs are different, but the spatial role is the same:
Глагольная приставка в положительной инс: Verb prefix in a positive directive
Глагольная форма одинакова. Разницу созд: The verb form is identical. The difference comes from the object:
Глубокий анализ видов спряжения, сложные: A deeper look at definite and indefinite conjugation, object pronouns such as engem, téged and titeket, the special -lak/-lek form (“I ... you”), and practical contrasts.
Глухая пара звука gy: положение языка по: The voiceless counterpart of gy, /c/. The tongue position is similar, but the vocal folds do not vibrate. English has no exact equivalent.

Говори 1,5–2 минуты. Используй 6 смыслов: Speak for 1.5–2 minutes. Use six content blocks and at least one -val/-vel form in a natural context.

Говори 1,5–2 минуты: объясни маршрут или: Speak for 1.5–2 minutes: explain a route or a simple procedure. Use a clear sequence, 4–5 instructions, and a consistent register.
Говори 1,5–2 минуты: что умеешь, чему хо: Say 1.5-2 minutes: what you can do, what you want to learn, what you have to do, what you don’t have to do, and what is forbidden in a familiar place.
Говори 1.5–2 минуты о вчерашнем дне: утр: Speak for about 1.5–2 minutes about yesterday: morning → daytime → evening. This is a text-only self-practice activity with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори 1.5–2 минуты о вымышленной покупк: Talk 1.5-2 minutes about a fictional purchase. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 1.5–2 минуты о вымышленном посеще: Speak for 1.5–2 minutes about an imaginary restaurant visit. This is a text-only self-practice task with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты и сравни два места,: Speak for 1–1.5 minutes comparing two places, products, or other familiar options. This is optional text-only self-practice with no microphone, automatic score, or evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты о вымышленной семье:: Speak for 1–1.5 minutes about a fictional family: relationships, age or job, and location. This is text-only self-practice with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты о местах дня: где на: Speak for 1–1.5 minutes about the places in your day: where you are, where you go into, and where you come out of. This is text-only self-practice with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты о простом маршруте п: Speak for 1–1.5 minutes about a simple route through town. Use the present tense and only grammar already covered in L1–L11. This is a text-only task with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори 2–3 минуты о вымышленной поездке:: Speak for 2–3 minutes about a fictional trip: destination, transport, schedule, one problem and how it was solved, hotel/accommodation, and an overall evaluation. Use past tense, sequence markers, an opinion, and a reason.
Говори 2–3 минуты по теме: Beszéljen a m: Speak for 2–3 minutes on the topic: Beszéljen a munkatapasztalatáról, a feladatairól, két erősségéről, és arról, milyen munkát keres. Mention a previous role or experience, responsibilities, two strengths, the kind of job you want, one reason, and when you could start.
Говори 2–3 минуты. Выбери тему: большой: Speak for 2–3 minutes. Choose a topic: large or small city; home or office; car or public transport; self-study or learning with a teacher. Structure your answer: position → reason → example → second reason → counterargument → response → conclusion.
Говори 30–60 секунд по опорам. Без микро: Speak for 30 to 60 seconds on the poles. No microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 90–120 секунд на ту же коммуникат: Speak for 90–120 seconds on the same topic, but do not repeat your written text word for word. Contrast your usual habits with a specific book, film, or programme you are reading or watching now.
Говори около 1 минуты о том, что ты обыч: Speak for about one minute about what you usually eat, drink, buy, read, or watch. This is a text-only self-practice task with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори около 1.5 минуты о дороге от дома: Speak for about 1.5 minutes about the route from your home or a station to a familiar place. This is a text-only activity with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори около 2 минут на тему: Mit csinál: Speak for about 2 minutes on: Mit csinálnál, ha egy hónapig nem kellene dolgoznod? Use at least four conditional forms, two reasons, and one ha-clause.
Говори около 2 минут о следующей неделе:: Talk about about 2 minutes about next week: work or school, one appointment, weekend plans, one expected event and one possible change. This is text self-practice without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори около 2 минут о типичном буднем д: Talk about a typical weekday for about 2 minutes and compare it to a weekend. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори около 2 минут. Назови любимый сез: Speak for about 2 minutes. Name your favourite season, typical weather, clothing, activities, and one example of weather changing your plan.
Говори около 2 минут. Это текстовая инст: Speak for about 2 minutes. This is a text-only instruction with no microphone, score, or evidence.
Говори около 2 минут. Это языковая практ: Speak for about 2 minutes. This is language practice, not a real medical assessment. Describe a recent fictional health problem: symptoms, onset, what you have already done, whether it became better or worse, and what you would ask a doctor.
Говори около 2 минут: будний день → врем: Talk about 2 minutes: weekday → time → transport → frequency → evening → one difference of the weekend. Without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори по шести опорам: когда → утро → д: Speak from six prompts: when → morning → daytime → person/place → one negative sentence → evening and opinion. Aim for about 1.5–2 minutes.
Говори примерно 1.5–2 минуты: что ты уме: Say for about 1.5-2 minutes: what you can do well, what you want to learn, what you have to do every day, what you don't have to do, what you don't have to do, what you don't have to do, what you don't do in a place you know, and that's just a textual basis for self-practice -- without writing down or evaluating.
Говори примерно 2–2.5 минуты и перескажи: Speak for about 2–2.5 minutes and retell a fictional event: setting, sequence, problem, action, outcome, and opinion. This is text-only self-practice, with no microphone, score, or evidence.

Готовность к A1 означает не знание всех: Readiness for A1 does not mean knowing all of these forms in advance, but a confident A0 base: you read familiar words, use articles, distinguish between a number and a plural, form the present tense, and understand a simple schedule.

Грамматически возможная форма не всегда: A grammatically possible form is not always the most natural utterance. Check the speech situation, not just the ending.
Грамматически знакомые слова ещё не гара: Grammatically familiar words don't guarantee a logical sentence. Check the order of events: morning → day → after work → evening.

Граница 19.6: контекстная интеграция изу: Scope of 19.6: contextual integration of the patterns you have learned. In 19.7, you will recognise the same functions in a connected text.

Граница 19.8: распознавание прошлого, на: Scope of 19.8: recognising past, present, and future reference by listening. In 19.9, these patterns are used to negotiate a new plan in a realistic conversation.
Граница 19.9: интеракция и изменение пла: Scope of 19.9: interaction and changing a plan. In 19.10, you will express the same functions coherently in writing and speech.

Граница 20.11: система прошедшего времен: Scope of 20.11: the past-tense system is now organised into one working map. The next slide shows which skills are checked automatically and which require human evaluation.
Граница 20.12: итоговый профиль курса вн: Scope of 20.12: the final in-app course profile. It records learning evidence but does not replace a full external proficiency assessment.
Граница 20.1: смысл прошлого и общая арх: Scope of 20.1: the meaning of the past and the overall form architecture. On 20.2, the third-person form becomes a learning reference; on 20.3, we build the personal forms of the indefinite conjugation.

Не вставляй форму искусственно ради гало: Do not insert the form artificially just to tick a box. It should genuinely express accompaniment or the means of an action.
Не выбирай -ba/-be просто потому, что в: Do not choose -ba/-be just because the sentence contains a motion verb. First identify the role of the place. If it is the destination, ask Hová?. A source is marked differently in 10.5.
Не выбирай вариант ответа по одному знак: Don't pick the answer for a word you know, but first find the proof in the text: the original plan, the reason for the change, the new arrangement or the forecast.
Не выбирай вариант только потому, что в: Do not choose an option merely because it contains a familiar word.
Не выбирай один из четырёх суффиксов и н: Do not choose one of the four suffixes and mechanically add ordinary endings. Learn the forms by grammatical person; the first-person form in -nék is especially important.
Не выбирай ответ по одному знакомому сло: Do not choose an answer from one familiar word. The questions test reasons, changes of plan, advice, and the family's final decision.
Don't pick an answer for one familiar word. For each question, find a sentence or phrase that serves as proof.
Не выбирай союз только по русскому перев: Do not choose the Hungarian conjunction from an English translation alone. First ask whether the result happens despite an obstacle (concession: although/even though) or depends on a condition being met (if).
Не выбирай суффикс по последней букве сл: Do not choose the suffix from the last letter of the word. Look at the vowels in the stem, especially the difference between front unrounded e/é/i/í and front rounded ö/ő/ü/ű.
Не выбирай форму по одному глаголу и не: Do not choose the form from the verb alone and do not translate the source preposition mechanically. First identify the role of the place: location, destination, or source.
Не выбирай форму по русскому «в / на / и: Do not choose the Hungarian form by mechanically matching English “in / on / from / off”. Standard Hungarian usage for a place may use a different case family.
Не выбирай форму по русскому предлогу и: Do not choose the Hungarian form from an English preposition and do not start with the suffix. First identify the spatial question:
Не выбирай форму только по русскому слов: Do not choose the form solely from a source-language word meaning ‘want’. First ask: am I simply stating an intention, or am I addressing someone politely?
Не выбирайте вариант только потому, что: Don't choose a variant just because the word looks familiar. The answer must match the verb, object, and sequence of events in the record.
Не выбирайте владельца только по прилага: Do not choose the owner only by adjective.
Не выбирайте ответ только по последней б: Do not choose the answer only by the last letter without checking the meaning.
Не выбирайте соединительную гласную толь: Don't choose a connective vowel from a simple table. vowel harmony helps, but doesn't always predict the form completely: asztalok, házak, kertek, gyümölcsök. It's useful to learn a new noun with its plural.
Не выводи гармонию заново. На этом этапе: Don't re-invent the harmony. At this point, the form should be recognized quickly.
Не выводи общее правило только из артикл: Don’t derive the general rule from a/az or egy. Here, two examples are a familiar guide; the complete system of definite/indefinite conjugation is wider.
Не выводи правило заново. Просто проверь: Don't re-infer the rule. Just check if you know the spelling correctly automatically.
Не выводите все формы из одного механиче: Don't deduce all forms from one mechanical rule. At A1, these frequent sets need to be known as proven models.
Не выводите точную форму только по одном: Don’t get the exact form by one rule of harmony:
Не выводите форму по последней гласной:: Do not display the form by the last vowel:
Не глядя на объяснения, классифицируй се: Without looking at the explanations, classify the seven examples: no object, object with an article, articleless object, pronoun, or first-/second-person object.
Не делай вывод «любое русское из = -ból/: Do not conclude that every English “from” or “out of” equals -ból/-ből. Leaving a surface uses another family, while moving away from a person or object uses a third. These follow Lesson 10.
Не делай вывод, что теперь можно механич: Do not assume that you can now mechanically form the past tense of any new verb. The goal of L13 is confident use of the forms you have learned in context.
Не делай правило «piros = светло-красный: Don't make the rule, "piros = light red, vörös = dark red." This mechanical division is unreliable. For a normal object, A1 is a safe active model:
Do not use the rule “movement → -hoz”. Movement answers Hová?, but the location pattern depends on the meaning: inside, a conventional location, or toward a reference point.
Не делай правило «придаточное = всегда t: Do not turn this into a rule that “subordinate clause = always tárgyas”. What matters is the function of that specific clause.
Не делай правило «русское в = L10» или «: Do not make a rule that English “in” always means L10 or “on” always means L11. These correspondences sometimes happen to match, but they are not a reliable way to choose the Hungarian case family.
Не делайте вывод только по окончанию.\n: Don't just infer from the end. For example, the form.
Не делайте вывод, что пропущенное местои: Do not assume that an omitted pronoun is always uniquely determined by the verb form. In Péternek hívnak, the meaning “me” comes from the conventional self-introduction context; hívnak itself does not encode a first-person object.
Не добавляем новую грамматику. Цель — бы: No new grammar is added. The goal is to retrieve already learned phrases quickly from a real situation.
Не добавляй -j к инфинитиву целиком. Сна: Do not add -j to the whole infinitive. First remove -ni and identify the stem. With some verbs, -j then assimilates to the final consonant or the form is irregular.
Не добавляй -t механически к любому глаг: Do not mechanically add -t to every verb. Hungarian has stem changes, linking vowels, and different personal endings. The full system is covered in L20.
Не добавляй leg- к исходному прилагатель: Do not add leg- directly to the base adjective: *legnagy, *legjó, and *legolcsó are incorrect. Recall nagyobb, jobb, olcsóbb first, then form legnagyobb, legjobb, legolcsóbb.
Не добавляй mert и ezért в одну цепочку: Do not automatically put mert and ezért into the same chain. First decide what is the reason and what is the result; sometimes it is better to split the idea into two sentences.
Не добавляй более сложные разговорные мо: Do not add more complex conversational ways of telling time yet; use only the clear basic pattern taught here.
Не добавляй личное окончание к инфинитив: Don't add personal endings to the infinitive. In the design of the future, fog changes, and the action stays in the basic infinitive.
Не добавляй лишние чувствительные сведен: Do not add unnecessary sensitive information or overstate your language level or experience. Include only information relevant to the vacancy.
Не добавляйте van после профессии, нацио: Do not add van after a profession, nationality or third-person name: Ő diák. Ő magyar. But for van location, you need Ő itt van.
Не добавляйте в это упражнение формы: Do not add forms to this exercise.
Не добавляйте предложение только ради ко: Don't add a sentence just for the sake of quantity. Four right short lines are better than six long lines with new and untested grammar.
Не добавляйте сложные новые формы только: Don't add complex new forms just for the sake of quantity. One clear and grammatically controlled possessive construction fits the rubric.
Не достаточно сказать только номер автоб: It is not enough to say only the number of the bus – name the exit point.
Не забудь назвать именно остановку выход: Don’t forget to name the exit stop, not just the bus number.
Не заменяй tud и lehet друг другом тольк: Do not treat tud and lehet as interchangeable just because English can use “can” for both. Tud primarily expresses a person’s ability/capacity; lehet + infinitive expresses situational possibility or permission.
Не заменяй обязанности общими словами. Л: Don't use generic words for responsibilities. It's better to say two or three things that are being tested: what is being answered, organized, decided, prepared or coordinated.
Не записывай только перевод существитель: Do not write down only the noun's translation.
Не заполняй пробел догадкой из «обычного: Don't fill the gap with a "normal routine" guess. The answer must come from the record.
Не заполняй таблицу по памяти из вариант: Do not fill in the table from memory or from the answer choices. First find the evidence in the text itself.
Не заполняй эту карту из вариантов ответ: Do not fill in this map from the answer choices. First find the relevant paragraph, and only then write a short note.
Не заполняйте категории по одному упомин: Don't fill in categories by mentioning a word, for example, a word might appear in a text as what Nora is looking for, but that doesn't prove she bought it.
Не заучивай model answer целиком. Сначал: Do not memorise the entire model answer. First identify the purpose of your turn, then build your own sentence from familiar patterns.
Не заучивай модели как один фиксированны: Do not memorize the models as one fixed dialogue. After the first run, replace könyvtár, kávézó, and étterem with other familiar places while keeping the same spatial roles.
Не заучивай полные model answers. Сначал: Do not memorise complete model answers. First identify the communicative function of your learner turn, and only then build the sentence.
Не измеряй прогресс только количеством в: Do not measure progress only by the number of words learned. Track what you understood, retold, wrote, said, and corrected.
Не используй -lak/-lek с вежливым Ön / Ö: Do not use -lak/-lek with polite Ön / Önöket. Grammatically these are third person, so the regular definite conjugation is used.
Не используй механическое правило «слово: Don’t use the mechanical rule “word + bb.” Forms *nagybb, *szépbb, *jóbb and *kicsibb are incorrect.
Не используй механическую формулу «увиде: Do not use the mechanical rule “take the third-person form and simply add a personal ending”. The surface form may change, as the next slides show.
Не используй правило «есть движение → Ho: Do not use the rule “there is movement → Hová?”. Movement can be toward a destination or away from a point of origin, so first identify the meaning of the situation.
Не используй правило «к любой словарной: Don't use the rule "just add -ni to any dictionary form." For frequent irregular verbs, the infinitive must be learned in its entirety.
Не используй реальные персональные данны: Don't use real personal data. Fictitious information is allowed for interviews, resumes and letters.
Не используйте transcript до первого сам: Don't use transcript until you first listen to it yourself, otherwise activity will stop listening.
Не используйте здесь новые формы könyvet: Don’t use the new forms könyvet, szavakat, and szeretem. The accusative case -t and the system-defined conjugation begin later; sentences are now only built from familiar A0 structures.
Не используйте знание реальных семей: вс: Don’t use real family knowledge: all families in the text are fictional.
Не ищем «возвратность» по -ik: сначала з: Do not infer reflexivity from -ik: start with the verb's meaning
Не ищи одинаковое ключевое слово в вопро: Don't search for the same keyword in question and answer. First, reconstruct the situation: where you are, where you are going, where you are coming from, ask for a route or correct a misunderstanding.
Do not choose an answer from one matching word. For each question, find a full sentence or connected sentences that support your choice.
Не ищите в аудировании историю про поезд: Do not look for the train story in the listening activity: the recording is about a different person and different events.
Не каждое название продукта является пря: Not every product name is a direct object, and not every product Nora buys is a direct object. First define the verb and the meaning of the action, and then decide what role the noun plays.
Не каждое предложение с ha имеет две усл: Not every sentence with ha has two conditional forms
Не каждый человек в предложении — прямой: Not every person mentioned in a sentence is a direct object
Не каждый элемент перед глаголом автомат: Not every element before a verb is automatically a contrast focus; in a neutral phrase, the verb can also have the usual additions and circumstances, and the focus is determined by the context, stress and location of the other elements.
Не копируй Reading 10.7 и не превращай т: Do not copy Reading 10.7 or turn the text into a list of forms. Write a connected route with actions. Use only the Lesson 10 interior location family; the other local case families come later.
Не копируй готовый образец. Сначала сост: Do not copy the model answer. First make your own seven-part content plan, then write the full text.
Не копируй полный образец до собственной: Don't copy the full sample before you try. A direct lehet question is enough to request an alternative; a new construction with a question particle is not studied separately here.
Не ловите отдельное знакомое слово.\n: Don't catch a single familiar word. Listen to a little bit of meaning:
Не меняй порядок шагов во время речи. Сн: Don't change the order of steps in your speech. First, name the first landmark, then the next.
Не механическое «слово + bb», а готовые: Not mechanical word + bb, but ready-made frequent forms:
Не называй mert, hogy и ezért взаимозаме: Do not treat mert, hogy, and ezért as interchangeable. They mark different links: reason, purpose/content, and result.
Не называй эти местоимения неопределённы: Do not call these pronouns indefinite. They refer to specific people, but they require the indefinite verb paradigm.
Не начинай писать сразу длинный абзац. С: Don't start writing a long paragraph at once. First, make a five-part plan: topic → option A → option B → direct comparison → choice and reason.
Не начинай пока образовывать сравнительн: Don't start forming comparative forms yet. In this step, the challenge is to learn the basic adjectives with confidence.
Не начинай с окончания. Начинай со смысл: Don't start with the end. Start with the meaning of the situation.
Не начинай с окончания. Сначала определи: Don't start with the end. First, define the spatial relation.
Не начинай с окончания. Сначала установи: Do not start from the ending. First establish who should act, whether there is a direct object, and which register is needed.
Не начинай с полного перевода русского т: Do not start by translating a complete text from Russian. First make a Hungarian outline using familiar activities, time expressions, and frequency words.
Не начинайте с полного перевода русского: Do not begin by translating a complete English paragraph. First build a short plan from Hungarian words and patterns you already know from the lesson.
Не начинайте сразу с длинного перечислен: Don't start with a long list of names. First, tell us which family you're talking about.
Не нужно говорить одинаково долго о кажд: You don't have to talk about each block the same length, but you have to get the listener to understand the sequence of the day.
Не нужно заново выводить правила. На чте: You don't have to re-devote the rules. You can read quickly enough to learn the meaning of a familiar person.
Не нужно каждый раз строить длинную исто: You do not need to produce a long story every time. A short, precise response is better than a complex sentence whose meaning is unclear.
Не нужно описывать второй полный распоря: You do not need to describe a second full routine. One clearly stated contrast is enough.
Не нужно повторять гармонию целиком. Зде: You don't have to repeat the whole harmony. You have to hear the difference.
Не нужно сейчас учить все порядковые фор: You do not need to learn every day-of-the-month form yet; understanding the pattern through a few common examples is enough.
Не нужно соединять предложения сложными: You do not need complex conjunctions here; these three connectors are enough at A1.
Не нужно специально чередовать два спряж: You do not need to force both conjugations into every story. First choose the meaning and object, then use the natural verb form.
Не нужно ставить связку перед каждым пре: You don't have to put a bundle before every sentence, use them where they help the reader see order.
Не образуйте множественное число механич: Don't create a plural mechanically. Compare: ajtó →  ajtók, lámpa →  lámpák, ágy →  ágyak, tükör →  tükrök. These words have different models.
Не образуйте формы olvassz, nézsz, főzsz: Do not form *olvassz, *nézsz, *főzsz, or *edzsz. The correct forms are olvasol, nézel, főzöl, and edzel. The ending is chosen according to vowel harmony.
Не образуя новых форм, распределите четы: Without forming any new verb forms, sort the four examples into two columns: indefinite object and definite object.
Не объединяй два разных слова в одну «фо: Don’t combine two different words into one form:
Не объясняй форму только как «двойная d»: Do not explain the form only as “double d”. Spelling matters, but first identify the object:
Не объясняйте anyja и apja правилом «кон: Don't explain anyja and apja by the rule "final a just disappears and j appears." It's not a universal mechanism. At A1 it's safer to learn three complete sets as ready-made models.
Не обязательно запоминать маршрут заране: You don't have to memorize the route in advance. These forms are the reference points that you'll use to reconstruct it as you read.
Не обязательно использовать все связки.\: You don't have to use all the ligaments. It takes a few natural compounds to make the sentences one situation.
Не обязательно использовать слово: You don't have to use the word.
Не обязательно строить сложный вопрос.\n: You do not need to form a complicated question. You can repeat the detail you heard with questioning intonation:
Не ограничивайся выбором союза. Для кажд: Do not stop at choosing a conjunction. For each answer, explain which clauses are connected and what logical relationship they express.
Не определяй адресата только по окончани: Do not identify the addressee from the ending alone. First establish who is speaking to whom and who the request is directed to.
Не определяй модель только по окончанию: Do not identify the conjugation from the verb ending alone. For example, iszom ends in -om, but with vizet it is an indefinite-conjugation form.
Не определяй спряжение только по внешнем: Do not identify the conjugation from the surface ending alone. The mi and ti forms coincide across the two paradigms, and kérnék can have two different grammatical analyses.
Не определяй спряжение только по окончан: Do not determine conjugation from the én ending alone. Forms such as vártam or olvastam do not by themselves show whether the object was indefinite or definite.
Не определяй тип спряжения по одному око: Do not identify the conjugation from the ending alone. First ask whether there is a direct object and, if so, whether it is definite.
Не ориентируйтесь только на общий процен: Don't just focus on the total percentage. Two students with the same score can make mistakes in different areas: reading, lenni, articles, verbs, numbers or schedules.
Не останавливайся на каждом незнакомом с: Do not stop at every unfamiliar word. Look for the sequence of places:
Don't stop at every word you don't know. First, find the familiar supports: busz, megálló, gyógyszertár, egyenesen, balra, könyvtár.
Не отвечай на вопрос о языках заученной: Don't answer a language question with a phrase you've learned if the level isn't true. In an interview, accuracy is more important than an impressive answer.
Не отвечай по общему впечатлению. Для ка: Do not answer from a general impression. For each answer, find a specific time, place, means of transport, action, or frequency word in the text.
Не отвечайте только по инструкции 8.7.mp: Do not answer only 8.7.mp3. activity results require listening to a separate entry of the task.
Не открывай model answer до своей попытк: Do not open the model answer before your own attempt. First structure the message, then check the content, and only then compare it with the model.
Не открывай вопросы как тест на память о: Do not treat the questions as a vocabulary-memory test. First understand the sequence of the story, then find textual evidence for each answer.
Не открывай транскрипт до отправки ответ: Don't open the transcript before you send the answers, otherwise the exercise stops checking the listening and turns into reading.
Не открывай транскрипт до первого прослу: Don't open the transcript until you first listen, otherwise the exercise turns into reading instead of listening.
Не переводи lenne автоматически как «я б: Do not translate lenne automatically as “I would be”. Lenne is third-person singular (“he/she/it would be”, depending on context); the first-person singular form is lennék (“I would be”).
Не переводи várd как «подожди это». В ес: Do not translate várd literally as “wait it”. In natural Hungarian, use forms such as várd meg őt or várd meg Annát — “wait for him/her/Anna”.
Не переводи погодные выражения слово за: Do not translate Hungarian weather expressions word for word from English. English may use patterns such as “it is sunny” or “it is raining”, while Hungarian weather expressions use several different constructions. Learn each Hungarian phrase as a complete unit.
Не переводи русские «в» и «из» механичес: Do not map English prepositions such as “in / into / from / out of” mechanically onto Hungarian suffixes. First identify the spatial relation. Lesson 10 covers only the interior family; Lessons 11–12 introduce other location families.
Не переводи русские «из / от / с» одним: Do not translate every English “from / out of / off / away from” with one Hungarian suffix. -ból/-ből belongs specifically to the interior family. Leaving a surface and moving away from a person or object use other families taught in Lessons 11–12.
Do not translate an English conjunction automatically. English words such as “that”, “so that”, and “if”, or a zero connector, do not map one-to-one onto Hungarian. First identify whether the clause expresses content, purpose, condition, cause, result, or another logical relation, then choose the Hungarian construction.
Не переводи русскую модель слово за слов: Do not translate an English pain expression word for word. English naturally says “My head hurts” or “I have a headache”. Hungarian uses fáj/fájnak with a possessed body-part form, so the possessor is already encoded in fejem, torkom, lábaim, etc.; an extra first-person pronoun is normally unnecessary.
Не переводи связующее слово изолированно: Do not translate a connector in isolation. English may use “and”, “but”, “while”, or “whereas” where Hungarian chooses és, pedig, viszont, or de. Choose the Hungarian connector from the logical relationship between the clauses, not from one English word.
Не переводи текст слово за словом. Снача: Don't translate word for word. First, understand the general situation, then find the specifics of the apartment A and the apartment B a second time.
Не переводи форму автоматически как прям: Do not automatically interpret the form as a direct command.
Не переводим любой русский дательный авт: Do not map every English “to” or “for” automatically to -nak/-nek. English usually expresses the recipient with word order or a preposition rather than a noun-case suffix. First check whether the Hungarian meaning is really a recipient or addressee.
Не переводим механически русские «у / к: Do not mechanically map English “at / by / near / to / from” onto Hungarian suffixes. First identify the spatial meaning and the type of relation, then choose the Hungarian location family.
Не переводите каждую форму механически к: Do not translate the forms mechanically. English normally requires a present-tense form of “be”: Diák vagyok means “I am a student.” Hungarian differs especially in the third person: van/vannak are omitted with professions, nationalities, and qualities, but kept for location and existence.
Не переноси автоматически английское пра: Do not assume that English future expressions such as “will” or “be going to” have a one-to-one Hungarian equivalent. Hungarian can naturally use a present-tense verb with a clear future-time marker, so first check the time expression and context.
Не переноси эту модель автоматически на: Don't automatically transfer this model to all city and place names. In Hungarian, the choice of local family often depends on the specific name; the next family starts in lesson 11.
Не переносите профессиональные формулы в: Do not transfer workplace formulas mechanically into a medical consultation. The new situation uses different vocabulary, questions, and forms of address.
Не переносите русские слова в венгерское: Do not build a Hungarian sentence by inserting English words or translating word for word. In the third person, do not add van with a profession or nationality. Check the exact forms vagyok, vagy, van, vagyunk, vagytok, vannak.
Не переносите русскую логику «конкретный: English does not change the verb according to whether the direct object is definite, so do not assume that “a specific person” automatically means Hungarian definite conjugation. First- and second-person objects belong to a separate Hungarian pattern that we will work through step by step.
Не переносите русскую форму множественно: Do not copy the English plural after a numeral into Hungarian. English says “two books” and “three houses”, but Hungarian uses the singular noun: két könyv, három ház. The verb is also normally singular with such a quantified subject: Két könyv van az asztalon.
Не переносите это объяснение на любой об: Don't transfer this explanation to any object before the verb. Here the focus is clear by the direct opposition of the verb to the verb.
Не перепутай будущее и знакомое прошедше: Don’t confuse the future with the familiar past:
Не перепутаны ли L10 и L11?: Have you kept L10 and L11 separate?
Не переходи на будущее время или сложные: Do not switch to the future tense or complex structures. The present tense is enough for this route: megyek, vagyok, tanulok, jövök, together with the familiar location forms.
Не переходи на новую грамматику. Возьми: Don't go to a new grammar. Take the following time marker:
Не перечисляй много времён подряд. Доста: Don't list too many times in a row. It's just 2-3 reference points that hold the structure of the story.
Не перечитывай список: распознай ситуаци: Do not reread the list: recognise the situation and choose the phrase yourself
Не пиши механически *vonatval, *késvel и: Do not write *vonatval, *késvel, or *pénzvel mechanically. After a consonant, the result shows assimilation rather than a separate v.
Не пиши полный монолог заранее. Подготов: Don’t write a full monologue in advance, prepare 6-8 keywords and speak in five blocks of meaning.
Do not write a complete monologue in advance. Prepare 6–8 keywords and speak from the content prompts.
Do not write a full monologue in advance. Prepare 6–8 keywords: item, companion, price, payment, problem, solution, outcome.
Не пиши полный монолог. Подготовь 6–8 кл: Do not write a full monologue. Prepare 6–8 keywords and speak from content blocks.
Не пиши полный текст заранее. Запиши 6–8: Don't write the full text in advance. Write down 6-8 keywords and talk to them. If you forget a word, make it easy, don't stop.
Не пиши полный текст по готовому образцу: Do not copy a complete model text. Plan the content from the rubric first, then choose the future forms required by the context.
Не пишите только список продуктов и не в: Don't just write a list of products or insert forms into -t mechanically. Select a verb first, then determine if a noun is a direct object: Otthon van kenyér, but Kenyeret veszek.
Не повторяйте всё одинаково. Используйте: Don't repeat it the same way. Use the diagnostics.
Не повторяйте одну и ту же фразу только: Do not repeat the same phrase just to increase the volume.
Не повторяйте правила как изолированные: Don’t repeat the rules as isolated shortcuts. Check them in whole forms: szép / sok, a könyv / az ablak, két könyv / könyvek, Két óra van / kettőkor.
Не повышай PARTIAL до DIRECT только пото: Do not upgrade PARTIAL to DIRECT just because the learner clicked 'complete'. Evidence status depends on the task type and how it is evaluated.
Не подменяй услышанное догадкой по одном: Do not guess from a single verb. Listen for the complete form of the location expression.
Не понимай фразу «одно прошедшее время»: Do not interpret “one past tense” as “one unchanging form”. Person, conjugation type, and the verb’s own past-tense pattern still matter.
Не превращай задание в список несвязанны: Do not turn the task into a list of disconnected sentences. Use familiar L10–L12 forms and route chunks; do not introduce the past tense before Lesson 13.
Не превращай каждую фразу о завтрашнем д: Do not turn every sentence about tomorrow into a future-tense lesson. At this level, first recognise ready-made forecast expressions and respond to their meaning.
Не превращай различие «настоящее / fog»: Don't make the "present/fog" distinction a hard rule. Both models can talk about the future; context and communication function are more important than one form.
Не превращай список реплик в механическо: Do not turn the list of lines into mechanical reading. At each stage, identify the communicative task first, then choose the form.
Не превращай чтение в урок образования в: Do not turn the reading into a lesson on forming every ending. For this text, it is enough to understand who acted and what happened.
Не превращай это в полную таблицу спряже: Do not turn this into a full conjugation table for the two verbs. In this lesson, it is enough to understand the difference in meaning and recognize the patterns in food contexts.
Не превращай это в правило «прилагательн: Do not turn this into the rule “Hungarian adjectives never change”. In predicate position, a plural subject normally takes a plural adjective: A házak nagyok. This differs from English, where the adjective in “The houses are big” does not change.
Не превращай этот блок в урок сравнитель: Do not turn this block into a lesson on comparatives. The goal is to explain why one day is more practical for an outdoor activity.
Не превращайте окончание -ik в универсал: Don't make the ending -ik into a universal algorithm. Not all modern verbs on -ik behave the same way, and there is variation in spoken language. For the A0 level, learn the frequency verb along with the forms én, te and ő.
Не применяй одно механическое окончание: Do not apply one mechanical ending to every word. For example, torok → torkom drops the vowel o, while kéz → kezem shortens long é to e.
Не применяйте к этим словам простую моде: Don’t use the simple vowel + k model to describe these words: forms.
Не применяйте правило «односложное слово: Don’t use the rule “a single word always gets –ak.” Compare: ház →  házak, láb →  lábak, but nap →  napok. In addition, some words change the basis: ló →  lovak, tükör →  tükrök, kéz kezek.
Не произносите каждую букву отдельно:: Do not say each letter separately:
Не произносите только отдельные слова:: Don't just say the individual words:
Не просто запоминай число. Сравни инстру: Don't just memorize a number. Compare Anna's instruction and action: that's what shows the error of understanding.
Не путай -kor и -ra/-re: hétkor означает: Do not confuse -kor and -ra/-re: hétkor means 'at seven', while hétre means 'by seven / for seven' in an appropriate context.
Не путай Hol? и Hová?: házban = в доме,: Do not confuse Hol? and Hová?: házban = in the house, where?; házba = into the house, where to? The final n distinguishes location from movement into a place.
Не путай Hol? с направлением. Если предм: Do not confuse Hol? with direction. If an object is already on a surface or a person is already at a place, you need a Hol? form, not a destination form.
Не путай Melyik? и Melyiket?. Melyik lak: Don't confuse Melyik? and Melyiket?. Melyik lakás...? — "What apartment ...??" Melyiket választja? — "Which one do you choose?": here you need an object with -t.
Не путай mert и ezért: mert вводит причи: Do not confuse mert and ezért: mert introduces the reason (“because”), while ezért points to the result (“therefore / so”).
Не путай два вопроса: общий вопрос о пог: Do not confuse the general weather question with the question asking for the exact number of degrees. They can describe the same situation but require different answers.
Не путай прилагательное перед существите: Do not confuse the adjective before the noun and the adjective-pronounce in the plural: nagy házak, but A házak nagyok. In the present tense of the 3rd person, a separate van with such a predicate is not put.
Не путай с дательным падежом прошлого ур: Do not confuse this with the dative from Lesson 15. Here the meaning is instrument/means or accompaniment: English may use “with” or “by”, while Hungarian uses the -val/-vel family.
Не путай три вещи: выбор -val/-vel по га: Do not confuse three things: choosing -val/-vel by vowel harmony, assimilation after a consonant, and the communicative functions “with what/by what means” and “with whom”. They are related but distinct steps.
Не путай три разные ситуации: késtem — я: Do not confuse three different situations: késtem = I was late; késett a busz = the bus was late; lekéstem a buszt = I missed the bus.
Не путай три уровня: описать текущую пог: Do not confuse three levels: describing current weather, understanding a forecast, and making a decision because of the forecast. They form a connected sequence but are not the same task.
Не путай это с пропуском уже известного: Do not confuse this with omitting a previously established definite object. In that context, the definite conjugation can remain. This distinction is covered on 21.3.
Не путайте kér и kérdez. Kér valamit озн: Do not confuse kér and kérdez. Kér valamit means “to ask for, request, or order something”. Kérdez means “to ask a question”.
Не путайте ti и вежливое «Вы». Ti означа: Do not confuse ti with formal address. Ti is informal plural “you”. Hungarian uses Ön for formal address to one person and Önök for formal address to several people. English “you” covers all of these, so pay attention to both number and formality.
Do not confuse vowel length with stress.
Не путайте конечную k основы со множеств: Don't confuse the final k basis with the plural. In ablak, the letter k is part of the word "window." The plural is ablakok. In combination három ablak, the word remains in the singular.
Не путайте русское множественное число с: Do not copy the English plural after a numeral into Hungarian. English “three chairs” is Hungarian három szék, not három székek. Also remember that the definite article a/az does not automatically mean “this”.
Do not confuse stress with vowel length. The marks in á, é, í, ó, ő, ú, and ű indicate vowel length, not stress.
Не пытайся выбирать суффикс только по по: Do not choose the suffix from the last letter alone. Look at the vowels in the stem and learn common forms as complete patterns. Mixed-vowel and loanwords may have lexical exceptions.
Не пытайся вывести все семь глаголов одн: Do not try to derive all seven verbs from one formula. Their value is their frequency: these forms should be recognised and used quickly.
Не пытайся вывести всю повелительную пар: Do not infer the entire imperative paradigm from four examples. This is a preview, not a complete rule table.
Не пытайся вывести эти четыре формы из о: Do not try to derive all four forms from a single classroom rule. At A2 level, it is more reliable to learn them as ready-made pairs.
Не пытайся говорить идеально или слишком: Do not try to speak perfectly or use language that is too complex. Eight to twelve short, clear sentences using familiar patterns are better than one long sentence with new grammar.
Не пытайся говорить сложнее своего уровн: Do not try to speak above your level. Six to eight simple, clear sentences in the right order are better than one long sentence using new grammar.

Не пытайся запомнить весь текст после од: Don't try to memorize all the text after one listening. First catch only the time marker, then the action and the form.

Не пытайся каждый раз заново вычислять ч: Do not try to re-derive every common irregular form each time. Learn it together with a typical situation and object.

Определённое повелительное наклонение ис: The definite imperative is used with a specific/definite object: ezt a könyvet (“THIS book”) → olvasd! (“read it!”). With an indefinite object: egy könyvet (“a/some book”) → olvass! (“read!”).
Определённое спряжение используется ТОЛЬ: The definite conjugation is used with definite third-person objects such as őt, azt, and a könyvet. First- and second-person objects such as engem, téged, minket, and titeket take the indefinite paradigm (Lesson 21, slide 4), except for the special én → téged/titeket -lak/-lek pattern.
Определённое спряжение используется, ког: The definite conjugation is used when the verb has a definite direct object, for example a/az + noun, ezt/azt, certain pronouns, proper names, or some clauses introduced by hogy. Without a definite direct object, use the indefinite conjugation.
Определённое условное наклонение использ: The definite conditional is used with a specific/definite object. In first-person singular: lát + n + á + m = látnám (“I would see IT”). Látnék is the indefinite conditional (“I would see something”).
Определённую парадигму выбирает не само: The definite conjugation is selected not by conditional meaning itself, but by a specific direct object, following the same principles as in the present and imperative.
Определённый артикль a/az не означает «э: The definite article a/az does not mean “this”. A könyv az asztalon van means “The book is on the table.” To say “this book”, use ez a könyv.
Определённый артикль, имя или местоимени: A definite article, proper name, or pronoun affects conjugation only when it functions as that verb's direct object.

Условная форма глагола со значением «моч: The conditional form of a verb meaning “can/be able to” asks whether the addressee can perform the action. It does not turn informal address into formal address: the addressee is still marked by the verb ending.
Условная форма может выражать не только: The Hungarian conditional is not limited to if-clauses. It can also express a wish, a softened intention, or a polite request. English may use would, would like, could, or other polite constructions depending on the function.
Условная форма уменьшает прямоту просьбы: The conditional reduces directness. Politeness also depends on the form of address, intonation, context, and softening expressions.
Условное значение в венгерском выражаетс: Hungarian marks conditional meaning on the verb itself. English often uses would + base verb, but there is no separate Hungarian word that corresponds one-to-one to English “would”; learn the Hungarian conditional as a verb form.
Условное наклонение делает просьбу преде: The conditional can soften the request. Kérhetnék is the first-person conditional form based on kérhet (“may/can ask”): “Could I ask...?” Kérhetnék egy kávét? is a polite café request (Lesson 23, slide 6).
Условное наклонение для \"mi\" (мы) в не: For mi (“we”), the indefinite conditional is tanul + n + á + nk = tanulnánk (“we would study”).

Цель повторной попытки — не выучить текс: The purpose of the second attempt is not to memorize the text, but to make your choice of forms more automatic.
Цель станции — не произнести названия бу: The purpose of the station is not to pronounce the names of the letters, but to read the word correctly. First, find the letter combination, then say the whole word with an emphasis on the first syllable.
Цель урока — решить типичные задачи поез: The goal of the lesson is to handle typical travel tasks: choose transport, buy or change a ticket, ask about a delay, check in at a hotel, and ask for directions.
Цель урока: не угадывать форму по звучан: The goal is not to guess a verb form from its ending, but to explain the choice through the type of direct object.
Цель финала — устойчивое и понятное испо: The goal of the final review is consistent, understandable language use—not perfect accuracy or mechanical reproduction of every table.
Цель — не воспроизвести список, а выбрат: The goal is not to reproduce the list, but to choose the right phrase for the situation: price, size, fitting, exchange or check.
Цель — не идеальная скорость, а связный: The goal is a connected Hungarian story, not perfect speed or translating back through English. A short pause is better than abandoning the sentence.
Цель — не повторить model слово в слово,: The goal is not to repeat the model word for word, but to keep the conversation going: answer briefly and meaningfully, use the past tense, and ask a question back.
Цель — понять последовательность событий: The goal is to understand the sequence of events and cause-and-effect links. Do not translate every word before answering the overall question.
Цель — понять сравнение и использовать е: The goal is to understand the comparison and use it to choose a plan. We do not expand the full comparative system here.
Цель — различать на слух три отношения L: The goal is to distinguish by ear the three ratios L12. Don't try to understand every word: listen to the person, the suffix, and the direction of the relationship.
